_comment: Single source of truth for published prices (NET amounts, as approved by the owner). Generated pages show consumer prices derived from these by templates/prices.mjs (see vat). Edit here, then run: node tools/build-prices.mjs (regenerates js/prices.js for the protected live calculator). Static HTML prices of the PROTECTED live pages are verified with: node tools/check-prices.mjs

vat.note: 21 % is a PLANNING ASSUMPTION only, not a final tax decision. The applicable rate and the final consumer price presentation (Spanish consumer-law compliant, tax-inclusive) must be closed from an official Spanish source and an accountant's approval (LGL gate stays open). While status != 'approved' the production gate refuses any page that shows a price. Company (B2B) quotes may show net price and IVA separately where lawful.

chemical.note: Net price per treatment occasion. A repeat chemical treatment costs the same as the matching first treatment.

drySteamStandalone.note: Net base price from. The final price depends on the on-site conditions, the surfaces involved and the extent of the infestation.

extras._status: approved by the owner on 2026-11-27 (work package 2), net prices. NOTE: the protected live calculator still uses the legacy 'addons' values below (steam +80 PER BEDROOM); the approved rule is a flat +80 per chemical treatment. Sync of live site / central price source / dispatcher is a pending owner task (docs/seo/OWNER-INPUT-REQUIRED.md).

steamAddOnToChemical.unit: flat, added to a chemical treatment

terms.repeatChemicalTreatment: same price as the matching first treatment; no automatic free second treatment; no approved fixed guarantee package
terms.travel: distance dependent - NO approved per-km fee, starting town or zone system yet (do not invent)
terms.urgentTreatment: normal price; availability depends on capacity (never a guaranteed same-day slot)
terms.followUpVisit: separate on-site follow-up check: individual agreement
terms.onSiteInspection: part of the ordered treatment (not sold as a stand-alone service)

addons._status: LEGACY values used only by the protected live calculator (js/prices.js): steam is +80 PER BEDROOM there. Do not use these for generated pages - use 'extras'.

retired: Completo plan (239/289/339/399 EUR, two visits, +50 per extra bedroom)
